entries.name: Greymanes
entries.how: Your own faction: camp recovery, comrades and commissions, starting at Howling Hill. Lines include Scattered Embers, Grounds of the Sunrise and Greymane Commissions. Commissions pay out Medium Bags. If progress stalls, switch back to Kliff. The game lists 100 journal entries for it (these include objective steps, not just separate quests). Check progress in Knowledge > Quests > Faction Quests. Quests: Garden of Trials, Homeward, Shield of Hernand, A Memory Beyond Ashes, Renewed Vitality, Reuniting with Comrades, Hope from Ashes, Strength Held in the Fingertips, Record of the Greymanes, A Taste of Home, For a Better Tomorrow, Brightening the Spirits, The First Steps of Little Marksmen, The Price of a Hangover, Words Left by the Riverside, Tales of the Greymanes, Riding with Pride, The Greymanes' New Fangs, Favorable Trade, Embers of Return, Gathered Will, Solid Foundation, Chance to Make a Fortune, Golden News from Yann, Strongbox with Wheels, Sweet Taste of Bounties, A Wider World.
